candidates.title: Multi-sender receive-side CPU, PCIe, and GPU burst isolation

officialAssets.name: QuantV2X
verifiedCapabilities: Training and offline inference paths for V2X-Real, OPV2V, and DAIR-V2X.
Codebook quantization utilities and a TensorRT export/inference path.
A cached path that serializes complete code tensors through NumPy and pickle.
missingCapabilities: No verified ROS subscriber, live multi-sender receive queue, or sender-isolated network receiver in the audited commit.
No verified official checkpoint bound to the audited commit and configuration.

officialAssets.name: V2X-ReaLO
verifiedCapabilities: The paper specifies ROS receipt, parsing or deserialization, CPU-to-GPU transfer, decompression, and a feature bank.
missingCapabilities: No verified official source commit or downloadable ROS bag was found in the frozen audit.

licenses.QuantV2X: UCLA Academic Software License; academic or nonprofit research only and redistribution constraints apply.

instrumentation.use: Construct fixed per-sender payloads and separate pickle deserialization from host-to-device transfer.
instrumentation.boundary: This is disk-backed batch replay, not a live receiver.

instrumentation.use: Add NVTX and CUDA-event timing around H2D, engine enqueue, kernel work, D2H, and synchronization.
instrumentation.boundary: The public utility uses one stream and has no multi-sender scheduler.

hardPreconditions: A checkpoint, configuration, and hashes that reproduce the baseline model.
At least three independently replayable non-ego sender payloads with controlled arrival phases.
A clear statement that offline replay is an independent reimplementation unless the official ROS receiver and bags are obtained.
procedure: Keep model, payload bytes, sender set, and decoded tensors fixed.
Compare synchronous burst, deterministic stagger, and randomized stagger arrivals.
Instrument deserialize, allocation, H2D, CUDA queueing, decode, fusion, and ego-output completion.
Compare FIFO or one-stream reception with bounded queues, preallocated pinned buffers, separated copy streams, ego-priority streams, and admission control.
Report p50, p95, p99, maximum, repeated-run intervals, and stage attribution.
passContract: A synchronous burst reproducibly increases p99 ego completion time.
The increase is attributable to at least one measured receiver stage.
Isolation reduces p99 without dropping senders, changing payload bytes, or changing model outputs.

closest: V2X-ReaLO measures receiver-side stages and resource contention but does not establish the proposed multi-sender burst and p99 isolation contract.
Cooperative Infrastructure Perception reports end-to-end p99 on a single-GPU multi-LiDAR system but not intermediate-feature receive isolation.
ARC reports scalable cooperative point-cloud processing but not the stated deserialize, H2D, CUDA-queueing causal decomposition.
collisionBoundary.allowedClaim: A fixed-payload multi-sender receive-burst benchmark with stage-level attribution and an ego-deadline isolation mechanism.
forbiddenClaims: A new cooperative perception model or compression method.
A V2X-ReaLO reproduction without official code and bags.
A tail-latency result inferred from average inference time.

candidates.title: A self-delimiting CodeFilling wire contract with legal decoding at every byte prefix

officialAssets.name: CodeFilling
verifiedCapabilities: PyTorch selection, quantization, tensor reconstruction, and fusion paths.
A communication mask whose reported rate is the selected spatial-cell fraction.
missingCapabilities: No working wire serialization baseline: EntropyCoder initialization is commented out while compress and decompress still reference it.
No framing, packet, stream cursor, partial-record state, or actual byte-rate measurement.
The official checkpoint folder returned HTTP 403 to anonymous access and its files, commit binding, and hashes remain unverified.
The paper's OPV2VH+ release was not located as a versioned public asset.

preconditions: Define a versioned self-delimiting schema, model or codebook identity, tensor shape, coordinate metadata, and integrity behavior.
Use a checkpoint and sample only for an end-to-end CodeFilling claim; a synthetic quantizer can validate only the parser.
For prefixes shorter than the complete header, return need-more or ego-only unless the required schema was negotiated before the message.
contract: Records are transmitted in a frozen utility order and contain enough metadata to be decoded independently.
An incomplete trailing record is ignored, never partially interpreted.
Every prefix deterministically returns ego-only, need-more, or features produced from complete records only.
No decoder reads beyond the supplied prefix or raises an unhandled error.
The complete byte stream reproduces the legacy tensor path within a declared tolerance.
tests: Enumerate every byte truncation point for one complete two-agent message.
Fuzz zero-length feed, fragmented feed, repeated feed, truncated headers, truncated records, and corrupted lengths.
Require fragmentation-independent results and nested complete-record sets.
Do not call separately re-optimized non-nested budget messages one progressive stream.

closest: RDcomm occupies layered vector quantization, utility priority, variable-length Huffman codes, and coarse-to-fine binary strings.
CoDS occupies digital bitstreams, channel coding and decoding, and reliability filtering.
ReVQom occupies multi-level residual vector quantization and successive reconstruction.
JigsawComm occupies utility-ranked units and one-model operation under varying budgets.
collisionBoundary.allowedClaim: A versioned, self-delimiting, fragmentation-independent CodeFilling record protocol plus exhaustive every-prefix conformance tests.
forbiddenClaims: New codebooks, residual quantization, Huffman coding, or digital cooperative-perception bitstreams.
First utility ranking or arbitrary-budget collaborative perception.
Monotonic AP improvement for every added byte without direct evidence.

sharedHardBlocks: No anonymously verifiable official checkpoint with configuration and checksum is available for either audited commit.
Neither candidate can establish its full real-network claim directly from the current public repository.
Both candidates require license review before redistributing a modified or derivative implementation.
